issues.location: Right column, end of north transliteration, labels64–65
issues.observation: Digital c64 ends serijekabu//rã :; c65 starts sebe masa. Kalinka c64 ends cabu- and c65 begins rã sebe masa. The digital break marker carries a fragment associated with the following printed label.
issues.disposition: Preserve digital strings and marker; cite span allocation separately. This does not establish whole-row identity, normalization or an accepted correction.

issues.observation: West transliteration d1–53 is on printed43; d54–71 continues on44. A page transition is not a missing inscription or a new witness.
Separate heading e) describes two fragments of uncertain north/west placement. They are not silently appended as additional c/d rows or admitted new Milyan objects.
